gate_definition: 18 common up + 36 common down genes (direction-gated Venn overlap of PBMC DEGs x tumor DEGs)
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: None on the gated set: Venn diagram + per-gene heatmaps (Fig 8); TCGA/GTEx COAD comparison of common transcripts (Suppl Fig S2)
D2_formal_test: No test on gated set. Formal tests only on per-tissue DEG lists (IPA Z>=2; BH-FDR in AltAnalyze; qRT-PCR t-tests)
D3_null_or_reference: IPA internal references / FDR; none for shared-set concordance
D5_independent_cohort: Partial: TCGA/GTEx COAD external comparison (supplementary); qRT-PCR technical validation only
evidence_paraphrase: Direction-defined overlap was displayed descriptively; no same-data concordance test was applied to the gated set.

gate_definition: 89 common up + 80 common down DEGs from 169 common DEGs of 583 overlapped genes (T2D GSE55650 x CRC GSE8671)
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: Not determinable from abstract; title/methods imply key-gene/hub prioritization
D5_independent_cohort: Not determinable; none stated in abstract
evidence_paraphrase: The abstract reports separate common up- and down-regulated gene sets; downstream inferential details were not recoverable from the abstract alone.

gate_definition: Direction-aware intersections A(up-up) B(down-down) C-D(discordant) per ASD-cancer pair; SDDC defined when A&B significant and C&D not (FDR<0.05)
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: YES: one-tailed Fisher exact on the four direction intersections; Venn of jointly deregulated genes; plus Pearson correlation on FULL meta-analysis profiles (all jointly studied genes not the gated set); GSEA + LINCS drug enrichment
D2_formal_test: YES: Fisher exact + FDR; Pearson profile correlation; GSEA
D3_null_or_reference: Fisher exact with background = genes jointly studied in the two meta-analyses (marginal-aware hypergeometric); GSEA standard nulls
D4_null_rebuilds_selection: Partial at most: null conditions on per-arm up/down marginals; the joint direction-gating workflow is not regenerated
D5_independent_cohort: No separate validation cohort; control diseases (ulcer colitis / malaria) used as external sanity anchors for known epidemiological links
evidence_paraphrase: Direction-specific intersections were evaluated with Fisher exact tests; the reported Pearson profile correlation used the full jointly studied gene set rather than the gated intersection.

gate_definition: 111 up + 16 down genes etiology-independent across 5 fibrosis datasets
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: Not determinable beyond abstract; enrichment in KEGG pathways stated in abstract; title implies prioritization for progression
evidence_paraphrase: The abstract reports etiology-independent up- and down-regulated genes; downstream reference construction could not be determined from the abstract alone.

gate_definition: 94 shared UPregulated genes across tissues (gated overlap; no significant downregulated overlap: 2 genes)
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: YES: hypergeometric overlap test on gated up-set (P=6.4e-78); Reactome overrepresentation on the 94 shared genes; WGCNA modules per tissue + module-overlap hypergeometric + module-preservation Z-summary; xCell
D2_formal_test: YES: hypergeometric overlap + BH; module overlap hypergeometric BH-corrected; module preservation Z-summary (permutation-based)
D3_null_or_reference: Hypergeometric background = merged-matrix genes; ReactomePA hypergeometric; WGCNA Z-summary permutation reference (for module preservation only)
D4_null_rebuilds_selection: Partial at most: gene-overlap nulls condition on DE lists; direction-gating workflow not regenerated; module-preservation null permutes module labels within networks
D5_independent_cohort: No independent cohort for downstream statistics (meta-analysis merges datasets internally)
evidence_paraphrase: The shared up-regulated overlap was formally tested with a hypergeometric framework and then used for pathway enrichment; the direction-gating workflow itself was not regenerated in the null.

gate_definition: 112 genes DE in both tissues; direction concordant for 103/112 (discussion; 106/112 in abstract) - concordance reported as property not gate for tests
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: Direction concordance reported DESCRIPTIVELY (no test); formal tests elsewhere: GSEA per tissue; pathway-overlap hypergeometric (p<0.001); Lasso blood classifier (6 genes) validated externally
D2_formal_test: Mixed: no test on the gated concordance object; formal tests: hypergeomatic pathway overlap; Bonferroni DE t-tests; GSEA q-values
D3_null_or_reference: ConsensusPathDB hypergeometric with array-background genes; standard GSEA
D4_null_rebuilds_selection: No (no concordance test existed to reference-build)
D5_independent_cohort: YES: Lasso IBD classifier validated on independent adult PBMC cohort GSE3365 (PPV 0.84 NPV 0.72; different platform); qRT-PCR validation
evidence_paraphrase: Cross-tissue directional concordance was reported descriptively; formal tests concerned pathways and a separate classifier rather than the gated concordance object.

gate_definition: 330 shared DEGs (191 up / 139 down) by NetworkAnalyst random-effects meta-analysis of 18 datasets (direction embedded in combined ES)
D1_downstream_on_selected_set: Construction-embedded inference: combined effect sizes + adjusted P define the shared set itself; downstream: PPI hub modules (Walktrap; descriptive degree/betweenness); ClueGO enrichment; WGS mutation overlap (descriptive)
D2_formal_test: YES but conflated with construction (meta-analysis P<0.05 IS the gate); enrichment P-values standard; no post-selection concordance statistic
D3_null_or_reference: Meta-analysis random-effects internals; ClueGO annotated-universe background
D4_null_rebuilds_selection: No (no post-selection inferential object beyond enrichment)
D5_independent_cohort: No independent validation cohort (18 datasets pooled; WGS comparison descriptive)
evidence_paraphrase: Meta-analysis statistics jointly defined the shared set and its significance; downstream network and enrichment analyses did not constitute a separate post-selection concordance test.
